sentences.text: The above appeal is filed against the award dated 9-04- 2021 in OP (MV) No. 859/2017 of The Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Pala.

The OP (MV) No. 859/2017 was filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 claiming compensation for the injuries sustained to the appellant in a motor traffic acoident, happened on 08-06-2017.
The appellant claims a compensation of  30,00,000/- (thirty lakhs only).

The Tribunal awarded a compensation of  10,35,031/-(Ten lakhs thirty five thousand and thirty one only) under various heads with interests at the rate of 8% from the date of petition (14/09/2017) till proportionate costs.
Challenging the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal, the above appeal is preferred.
2. The 3rd respondent had admitted the coverage of insurance policy in respect of the offending vehicle and its liability to pay compensation.
In the above circumstance, the appellant and 3rd respondent had agreed to have negotiation, in order to settle the disputes in between them.

3. It is agreed that the 3rd respondent Insurance Co shall pay an additional of  1,10,000/-(One lakhs Ten thousand only), inclusive of all the interests and costs to the appellant, by way of full and final settlement of all the claims of the appellant against the respondents.

4. The 3rd respondent hereby agrees to deposit the above amount before the Tribunal, within a period of 2 months from the date of receipt of the certified copy of judgement of this honourable Court and in case of default as stated above, the 3rd respondent, Insurance Co, is liable to pay interest at the rate of 8% p.a. from the date of default, till the deposit.
5, The above settlement is arrived at without any coercion or undue influence from any comer to either the appellant or to the 3rd respondent.
This settlement will form part of the judgement of the honourable High Court of Kerala.
